- It runs `id_token.verify_oauth2_token(token, requests.Request(), audience=SUB_AUDIENCE)`.
- `except Exception as err` -> msg = `"Invalid token: {err}\n"`.
- `if not claim["email_verified"] or claim["email"] != SUB_SERVICE_ACCOUNT` -> msg = `"Invalid service account or email not verified for email: {claim['email']}\n"`.
- Otherwise msg = `""`.
- The function only returns msg and acts on nothing itself.
